recreation_brief: 1. Create a blank slide with a light gray background (#F2F2F2). 2. Add a thin border frame around the slide edges. 3. Insert a centered text box in the middle of the slide. 4. Type 'Revision of Standard Linear' on the first line and 'Regression Model' on the second line. 5. Format the text as bold, red (#FF0000), sans-serif, and very large (approximately 60–72 pt). 6. Add a small yellow circle (#FFFF00) with a thin black outline in the top-right corner. 7. Place the numeral '2' inside the circle in small black text. 8. Optionally add a small gray plus sign near the top-center-right if replicating the annotation artifact.
